creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-02 on 0.20.0, devenv panes viewed from the laptop's window. Four Claude Code panes the daemon had resumed that morning with `claude --resume <id>`, with no turn since, reported `context_used` 0 in `muster window --json` (`0% context` in `muster window`). Their transcripts' last assistant usage records said 478k, 513k, 607k and 697k tokens. Every other pane's figure matched its transcript.

Costs: an agent choosing which idle panes to restart, skipping any over 300k tokens, would have restarted the four largest sessions, the ones the rule was meant to spare. Nothing marks the 0 as a figure no turn has produced yet.

Inferred, not confirmed: the figure is the status line's `context_window.used_percentage` (extras/claude-code/statusline.sh), and a freshly resumed Claude Code reports 0 there until its first request. Not rechecked on 0.22.

Possibly: after a resume, report the context as unknown until a turn has run, or seed it from the session transcript's last usage record.
title: A Claude Code pane the daemon resumed reads 0% context until its next turn
